slides.headline: He started at P&G in 1989 as an assistant brand manager. In January 2026, he became its CEO.
Shailesh Jejurikar named CEO of Procter & Gamble
slides.body: On July 28, 2025, P&G announced Jejurikar - then Chief Operating Officer - would become President and CEO effective January 1, 2026, the first India-born chief executive in the company's roughly 188-year history.

slides.headline: $84.3 billion in annual sales, around 109,000 employees.
slides.body: Born in Mumbai, Jejurikar studied at Elphinstone College and IIM Lucknow before joining P&G in 1989 on a personal healthcare brand in India. He rose through Fabric Care, Home Care, and regional leadership roles over 36 years before reaching the top job - and in August 2026 was also named Chairman of the Board.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: A 36-year career, one company, two top jobs.
slides.body: The man who started on the lowest rung of P&G's brand ladder in India now runs the company behind Tide, Pampers and Gillette - and holds both the CEO and Chairman title at once.
